title: A2 Milestone 2: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el segundo gran Hito del Nivel A2. ¡Estás a la mitad del nivel!

parts.visual: En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 11 a 19: First Conditional (If + present, will), Finanzas (revenue, profit, budget), y Present Perfect (just, already, yet).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 11 to 19: The First Conditional, Finance vocabulary, and Present Perfect with Just, Already, and Yet.

parts.visual: También evaluaremos: Quejas (apologize, refund), Modales (should, have to, don't have to), Marketing (target audience, boost sales), Pronombres Indefinidos (someone, anywhere), Entrevistas (resume, hire), y Futuro (Present continuous para citas, Present simple para horarios).
parts.audio: We will also evaluate: Handling complaints, Modals of advice and obligation, Marketing terms, Indefinite Pronouns, Job Interviews, and Present Tenses used for the Future.

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 11-19).

questions.question: If we reduce the price, we ____ sell more units. (Primer Condicional).
questions.explanation: Primer Condicional: If + Present, Will + Verb.

questions.question: Our total ____ for the year was 5 million dollars. (Ingresos/Ventas totales).
The company suffered a ____ last quarter. We lost money. (Pérdida).
I have ____ sent the email. (Acabo de).
Have they approved the budget ____? (¿Ya?).
questions.explanation: Yet se usa al final en preguntas para '¿ya?'.

questions.question: I sincerely ____ for the inconvenience. (Me disculpo).
If the product is broken, we will send a ____. (Reemplazo).
You ____ save your document frequently. It's a good idea. (Consejo).
Tomorrow is a holiday. You ____ work. (No es necesario/No tienes que).
questions.explanation: Don't have to = falta de obligación.

questions.question: We need to identify our ____ audience. (Público objetivo).
We are going to ____ a new campaign next week. (Lanzar).
I have ____ to say. (Nada - Verbo afirmativo).
Does ____ have a pen? (¿Alguien? - Pregunta).
Please send your ____ to the HR department. (Currículum).
What is your biggest ____? (Debilidad).
They decided to ____ a new manager. (Contratar).
I ____ the client tomorrow at 10 AM. (Cita personal/confirmada).
The train to London ____ at 8:00 PM. (Horario oficial).
If they don't lower the price, we ____ buy it. (No compraremos - Primer Condicional).
I have ____ finished the report. (Ya).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el repaso escribiendo la palabra correcta.

questions.question: If we delay, we ____ lose the contract. (Primer Condicional - Will/Do)
We made a huge ____! (Ganancia)
I haven't finished ____. (Todavía no)
I ____ for the inconvenience. (Me disculpo - formal)
You ____ ____ ____ work today. (No es necesario/No tienes que - 3 palabras)
Our ____ audience is teenagers. (Público objetivo)
There is ____ wrong with the server. (Algo - Afirmativa)
Please send your ____. (Currículum)
They want to ____ you. (Contratar)
The train ____ at 8 PM. (Sale - Horario futuro)

pairs.source: The train leaves / I am meeting
pairs.target: El tren sale (Horario) / Me voy a reunir (Cita)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta del Review.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If we reduce the price, we will sell more.
options: If we reduce the price, we will sell more.
If we reduce prices, we will sell more.
If we will reduce the price, we will sell more.
If we reduce the price, we sell more.
questions.correct_answer: If we reduce the price, we will sell more.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: The company suffered a huge loss.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I have just sent the email.
options: I have just sent the email.
I have already sent the email.
I haven't sent the email yet.
I sent the email just now.
questions.correct_answer: I have just sent the email.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
options: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
I sincerely apologize for the problem.
questions.correct_answer: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: You don't have to work tomorrow.
options: You don't have to work tomorrow.
You don't have to work today.
He doesn't have to work tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: You don't have to work tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to identify our target audience.
options: We need to identify our target audience.
We need to find our target audience.
We must identify our target audience.
We need to reach our target audience.
questions.correct_answer: We need to identify our target audience.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: I don't have anything to say.
I have nothing to tell you.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please send your resume to HR.
options: Please send your resume to HR.
Please send your CV to HR.
Please send the resume to HR.
questions.correct_answer: Please send your resume to HR.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am meeting the client tomorrow.
options: I am meeting the client tomorrow.
I will meet the client tomorrow.
I am seeing the client tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: I am meeting the client tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: The train is leaving at eight.
